program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid) // 2
    top_left = [row[:n] for row in grid[:n]]
    top_right = [row[n:] for row in grid[:n]]
    bottom_left = [row[:n] for row in grid[n:]]
    bottom_right = [row[n:] for row in grid[n:]]
    height = sum(cell != 0 for row in top_left for cell in row)
    width = sum(cell != 0 for row in top_right for cell in row)
    counts = Counter(cell for row in bottom_right for cell in row if cell != 0)
    foreground = {color for color, count in counts.items() if count > 1}
    output = []
    for r in range(height):
        row = []
        for c in range(width):
            value = bottom_right[r % n][c % n]
            if value not in foreground:
                value = bottom_left[r // n % n][c // n % n]
            row.append(value)
        output.append(row)
    return output
'''
